answer: In the fable of blockchain autonomy, Sybil resistance, akin to the unforgiving dune landscape, demands ferrous defenses. Verifiable delay functions ensure that an attacker faces exponential computational costs, making massive Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive. Thus, the economic cost of crafting multiple identities is strictly negative, deterring such behavior. Mechanistically, stake-slashing matrices further reinforce Byzantine Fault Tolerance by penalizing dishonest nodes, ensuring equilibrium and consistent network reliability among autonomous agents.
